ps1.8:1.4: Anicce Bhikkhave ‘niccan' ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso,
ps1.8:1.5: dukkhe Bhikkhave ‘sukhan' ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso,
ps1.8:1.6: anattani Bhikkhave ‘attā' ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso,
ps1.8:1.7: asubhe Bhikkhave ‘subhan' ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
ps1.8:1.8: Ime kho Bhikkhave cattāro saññāvipallāsā cittavipallāsā diṭṭhivipallāsā.
ps1.8:2.1: Paṭis_I,VIII.2: Cattāro 'me Bhikkhave na-saññāvipallāsā na-cittavipallāsā na-diṭṭhivipallāsā.
ps1.8:2.3: Anicce Bhikkhave ‘aniccan' ti na-saññāvipallāso na-cittavipallāso na-diṭṭhivipallāso,
ps1.8:2.4: dukkhe Bhikkhave ‘dukkhan' ti na-saññāvipallāso na-cittavipallāso na-diṭṭhivipallāso,
ps1.8:2.5: anattani Bhikkhave ‘anattā' ti na-saññāvipallāso na-cittavipallāso na-diṭṭhivipallāso,
ps1.8:2.6: asubhe Bhikkhave ‘asubhan' ti na-saññāvipallāso na-cittavipallāso na-diṭṭhivipallāso.
ps1.8:2.7: Ime kho Bhikkhave cattāro na-saññāvipallāsā na-cittavipallāsā na-diṭṭhivipallāsā.
ps1.8:8.1: Ime cattāro vipallāsā diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā appahīnā ti.
ps1.8:8.3: Anicce ‘niccan' ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno;
ps1.8:8.4: dukkhe ‘sukhan' ti saññā uppajjati, cittaṃ uppajjati, diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno;
ps1.8:8.5: anattani ‘attā' ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno;
ps1.8:8.6: asubhe ‘subhan' ti saññā uppajjati, cittaṃ uppajjati, diṭṭhivipallāso pahīno.
ps1.8:8.8: dvīsu vatthūsu dve vipallāsā pahīnā, cattāro vipallāsā appahīnā;
ps1.8:8.9: catūsu vatthūsu aṭṭha vipallāsā pahīnā, cattāro vipallāsā appahīnā ti. Vipallāsakathā. I Paṭis_I,IX.1: ‘MAGGO' ti. Ken' aṭṭhena
